units.name: Active UKDL Compilation
units.text: Don't load all UKDL always; mission context selects the relevant failure-family subset to keep signal high.

units.name: Adversary Quality Feedback
units.text: A synthetic adversary's confidence rises when its predictions prove real and is recalibrated when it produces noise.

units.name: Anti-Delete Stale-Replica Law
units.text: Distilled from LuckPerms issue #2764 (distributed stale-state deletion risk).

units.name: Applicability Contract
units.text: A scoping contract attached to each promoted standard declaring which construction categories (UNIVERSAL, CONSTRUCTION-WIDE, WORLD-WIDE, DYNAMIC-WORLD, SOCIAL, COMPETITIVE, NESTED, etc.) it applies to.

units.name: Applicability First
units.text: A capability is universally considered but not universally applied; tier determines treatment after applicability, not applicability itself.

units.name: Applicability-Tiered Gate Ladder
units.text: Five-tier classification determining which gates (tests, contracts, lifecycle, dry-run, degraded mode, canaries) apply, keeping maximum maturity with minimum ceremony.
entities: TRIVIAL PURE FUNCTION / USER-FACING FEATURE / STATEFUL FEATURE / HIGH-RISK MUTATION / PRODUCTION-CRITICAL SYSTEM

units.name: Architectural Failure Mining
units.text: When multiple local bugs share a superior cause, promote the fix from implementation issue to architectural defect.

units.name: Architecture Gap Detection
units.text: Some bugs arise because architecture never defined ownership; the learning elevates the architecture baseline.

units.name: Artifact + Capability + Immunity + Meta-Learning Output
units.text: All important work potentially produces four outputs: A Artifact, B Capability Delta, C Immunity Delta, D Meta-Learning Delta.
units.canonical_key: artifact capability immunity meta learning output

units.name: Assumption Falsification Before Implementation
units.text: When cheap, test an assumption before building on it to avoid large failure cascades.

units.name: Assumption Registry
units.text: Registry of significant failures produced by false assumptions, teaching which assumptions are historically dangerous.

units.name: Assumption Risk Priors
units.text: If a new mission's plan depends on a historically fragile assumption, raise the evidence requirement.

units.name: Auto-Diagnosis Packs
units.text: For mature families: symptoms→probable causes→falsification steps→evidence requirements, composing debugging itself.

units.name: Autonomous Convergence Contract
units.text: A transversal execution law stating "one human intent → as many internal iterations as necessary → verified target satisfaction," redefining "one-shot" as referring to human involvement rather than internal attempt count; Claude must iterate autonomously (verify, measure delta, correct, re-execute) rather than declaring completion after the first pass.

units.name: Baseline Activation Map
units.text: Explainable record of each capability's applicability, reason, evidence, and enforcement mode for a mission — no hidden magic.

units.name: Baseline Canary Portfolio
units.text: Representative consumer archetypes (CLI, desktop, backend, stateful service, plugin, agent, web UI, data pipeline) any universal capability must pass.

units.name: Baseline Compiler Regret
units.text: Post-mission review of what activated unnecessarily, what should have activated but didn't, and what appeared too late.

units.name: Baseline Completeness Genome
units.text: A contract/schema (not a system) defining what "completely industrialized" means for a software family across 23 dimensions (Intent, Reference Truth, Architecture, Configuration, Environment, Cold Birth, Oracle, Testing, Adversarial Testing, Integration, Production Reality, Performance, Metrology, Resource Envelope, Portability, Supply Chain, Recovery, Operability, Reconstructability, Known Limitations, Roadmap, Evidence, Evolution), extracted from kimi-k3-in-c's completeness.

units.name: Baseline Conformance Manifest
units.text: Per-mission report of inherited baseline, activated/not-applicable/advisory/blocking/override counts and novel gaps discovered, making the baseline auditable.

units.name: Baseline Coverage
units.text: The percentage of a new construction's requirements already solved by mature baseline capabilities before any new work begins.

units.name: Baseline Debt
units.text: Explicit registered debt when a repo cannot meet current baseline, with severity, exposure, migration cost, touch priority.

units.name: Baseline Drift Detector
units.text: A detector that catches new systems quietly reimplementing a worse version of a capability that already has a higher proven baseline elsewhere.

units.name: Baseline Escape
units.text: Incident where a supposedly-prevented known failure family escaped anyway; investigated for applicability/retrieval/enforcement failure or an incorrect rule.

units.name: Baseline Gap Report
units.text: Report comparing a repo's current baseline generation to required, listing named gaps prioritized by severity × exposure × leverage × migration cost.

units.name: Baseline Invalidation
units.text: New evidence invalidating a rule marks affected capabilities/consumers/baselines/tests/projects as potentially stale so incorrect knowledge isn't inherited.

units.name: Baseline Investment
units.text: IFC choosing to invest in universal infrastructure (e.g. transactional mutation) over a single feature because systemic leverage is higher.

units.name: Baseline Lift
units.text: A metric tracking how much a capability's baseline level rose as a direct consequence of a given feature's work.

units.name: Baseline Lineage
units.text: Every requirement must trace back through baseline version, UKDL doctrine, evidence, and historical incidents to avoid architectural religion.

units.name: Baseline Promotion Gate
units.text: The multi-phase evidence gate a candidate capability must pass (local success, repeated success, cross-host, cross-type, adversarial, production reality, regression proof, transfer confidence) before it can be promoted to baseline.

units.name: Baseline Promotion (UBC states)
units.text: Seven-state promotion lifecycle requiring evidence, scope, applicability, regression, consumer proof, and risk assessment before a UKDL rule becomes baseline.

units.name: Baseline Revocation States
units.text: Five-state mechanism for a universal baseline to lose authority without erasing history.

units.name: Baseline Versioning (UPB)
units.text: Each promotion produces a new numbered Universal Production Baseline Generation carrying new invariants, verifiers, primitives, revocations, applicability predicates, genomes, or autonomy requirements.

units.name: Batch/Transactional Primitive Preference Law
units.text: Universalization of KME's FAWE-only rule: use the highest-level batch/transactional primitive available instead of naive item-by-item mutation when empirically justified.

units.name: Before-Mission Phase (UBC PRE-COMPILE)
units.text: Ordered pre-implementation sequence: Mission Intent->Reality Scan->Project Genome->Mission Genome->Authority Resolution->Applicability->Failure Forecast->UKDL->Human Intervention Forecast->Production Reality Contract->Mode selection->Baseline Capsule.
units.canonical_key: before mission phase ubc pre compile

units.name: Bidirectional Traceability
units.text: Traceability chain Incident→Vault→UKDL→baseline→validator→future mission, and reverse from a future validator failure back to original evidence.

units.name: Boundary First Principle
units.text: High defect density tends to appear at boundaries; the Failure Pack must weight this.

units.name: Bug Density Map
units.text: Tracked failure density by subsystem, boundary, capability, and lifecycle phase to reveal systemic weaknesses.

units.name: Bug-Driven Knowledge Graph
units.text: Graph connecting failure families to capabilities, baselines, projects, tests, UKDL entries and primitives, enabling blast-radius queries.

units.name: Bug Escalation Levels
units.text: Four-tier live bug classification determining analysis depth so equal energy isn't spent on all bugs.

units.name: Bug Knowledge Sanitization
units.text: Before universalizing, remove credentials/personal data/unnecessary proprietary detail while preserving technical mechanism.

units.name: Bug Learning Priority
units.text: Resource depth is proportional to severity + reuse + novelty + causal leverage — trivial typos get local fixes, strange distributed failures get deep analysis.

units.name: Bug Learning Yield (BLY)
units.text: Not all bugs produce equal learning; measures institutional value per bug (a subtle infra bug can outweigh 100 trivial bugs).

units.name: Bug-Triggered Ultra Analysis
units.text: Only for data corruption, architecture-wide failure, critical recurring family, or universal baseline failure does deep analysis get triggered.

units.name: Bugfix Escalation Question
units.text: Mandatory post-fix question: can the possibility of this error be removed rather than merely detected, and if ROI-positive, elevate the solution.

units.name: Bugfix-to-Primitive Pipeline
units.text: When several fixes converge: local fix→reusable utility→certified primitive→platform service.

units.name: Bugs as R&D Signal
units.text: A cluster of failures around one abstraction can indicate a foundational architecture error that IFC should detect rather than endlessly patch.

units.name: Cache & Derived-State Integrity Pack
units.text: UBC pack activated by cache/memoization/materialized-view/session-replica usage; compiles source-of-truth declaration, key completeness, invalidation, lifecycle, freshness, coherence, stale-delete protection, reconciliation.

units.name: Canary Portfolio (UBC)
units.text: Universal changes tested across CLI/web/desktop/stateful-service/plugin/agent/data-pipeline/legacy archetypes; higher reuse multiplier requires higher evidence burden.

units.name: Canonical Application Boundary
units.text: The rule that all product surfaces (UI, TUI, CLI, SDK, agents, automation) must converge through one canonical capability boundary; when a surface lacks an operation, the boundary is improved, never bypassed with privileged internals access.

units.name: Capability Authority Registry
units.text: A registry naming, for each problem class (e.g. SPATIAL_TRANSFORMATION), the single authoritative implementation/capability that must be used unless a real cause justifies divergence.

units.name: Capability Authority Resolution
units.text: Before designing anything, UBC checks whether CPP already knows how to solve this problem class (current authority, certified primitive, Golden Path, known failed alternatives).
entities: ABSENCE MUST BE PROVEN BEFORE REINVENTION

units.name: Capability Graph
units.text: A dependency graph of capabilities (e.g. Professional Nested Building depends on semantic volumes, entrance interfaces, host DNA inheritance, terrain integration, mutation transactions, integration oracle) enabling downstream re-evaluation when a dependency improves.

units.name: Capability Ratchet
units.text: The core mechanism assigning each named capability a current baseline level (e.g. B7) that every relevant new construction must meet at minimum.

units.name: Capability Slicing / Capability Compression
units.text: Capability Slicing reduces "build the whole original system" to "interpret an existing artifact + simulate/render only necessary parts" (e.g., CavEX loading existing Beta world saves rather than implementing world generation). Capability Compression formally analyzes the minimum representation capable of producing the maximum perceptible/functional value (e.g., 35 of 100 architectural complexity units).

units.name: Capability Yield per Construction
units.text: A metric counting how many reusable improvements a given mission produced.

units.name: Causal Falsification
units.text: A known genome must not over-bias diagnosis; hypotheses must still be falsified to avoid cargo-cult debugging.

units.name: Certified Primitive Substitution
units.text: When a doctrine is already implemented by a certified primitive, inject "use primitive X + composition contract" instead of the full doctrine — strongest form of context compression.

units.name: Claim-Evidence Type System
units.text: Treats claims as typed; e.g. UNIT_TEST_EVIDENCE cannot satisfy PRODUCTION_REALITY_CLAIM, SCREENSHOT cannot satisfy BACKEND_EFFECT_CLAIM, structurally blocking False Done.

units.name: Claimed Success Causality Law
units.text: Universalized from an EssentialsX-style bug where a cancelled operation still showed a success message.
entities: CLAIMED SUCCESS MUST BE CAUSALLY DOWNSTREAM OF VERIFIED SUCCESSFUL EFFECT

units.name: Claude Power Pack Universal Construction Ratchet & Compounding Intelligence Fabric
units.text: The universal, host-resident, mandatory layer adapted from the KME flywheel for Claude Power Pack: it observes everything built by Claude Code, converts it into an institutional record, compiles the best applicable baseline for the next work, and closes the loop even when Claude Power Pack is not activated in the repo.
entities: Claude Power Pack Universal Construction Ratchet & Compounding Intelligence Fabric
units.canonical_key: claude power pack universal construction ratchet compounding intelligence fabric

units.name: Code Archaeology From Failures
units.text: Consult provenance for inexplicable legacy checks instead of "simplifying" by deleting immunity.

units.name: Compile Before Mutate
units.text: Universalized version of KME's Intent→semantic model→blueprint→dry-run→spatial validation→build plan→transaction→verify→commit/rollback pipeline for high-risk operations.
entities: INTENT → MODEL → PLAN → PRECONDITIONS → DRY-RUN/FALSIFICATION → APPLY → VERIFY → COMMIT

units.name: Compiler Self-Improvement
units.text: UBC tracks which requirements it activated, which were useful vs noise, and which omissions caused problems, measuring Precision/Recall/Miss Rate/False Activation/Scope Inflation/Net Benefit.

units.name: Complete Recursive Loop
units.text: Full pipeline bug→capture→reproduce→root-cause→failure genome→violated invariant→analogous exposure search→exact regression→family adversaries→Knowledge Vault→UKDL distillation→baseline promotion→automated detector→failure pack update→future plans anticipate family→latent exposures discovered→incidents prevented→human intervention falls→IFC measures leverage→higher investment→failure model improves.

units.name: Completion Gap Incident
units.text: Classification applied when a bug escaped because Done did not include the correct dimension.

units.name: Composition Compilation
units.text: UBC detects overlaps between activated packs (e.g. UI success depends on API result depends on persistent commit) and creates one causal verification chain instead of summing 30 requirements.

units.name: Composition Failure Library
units.text: Repository of historical failures caused by interactions between correct components.

units.name: Composition Opportunity Mining
units.text: A post-promotion process asking what new combinations are now possible (e.g. dynamic mutation + nested builds + temporal lifecycle -> hot-swappable seasonal districts).

units.name: Compositional Baselines
units.text: The mechanism by which an archetype compiler declares needed capabilities and the platform automatically composes mature providers, instead of each construction manually programming every subsystem, making KME a Construction Capability OS.

units.name: Concrete Incident Dossier
units.text: The instance-specific documentation of a bug, describing exactly what happened including identity, environment, symptom, expected/actual, evidence bundle, hypotheses (including falsified ones), root cause, causal chain, fix, regression, and residual risk.

units.name: Concurrency Failure Genomes
units.text: For concurrent systems, capture ordering, races, duplicate execution, stale reads, lock inversion rather than only exact traces.

units.name: Constitutional Failure Laws (Section CC)
units.text: Block of twelve capstone invariants (e.g. every material failure needs explicit disposition; a fixed bug isn't closed until causal family and prevention value are evaluated; recurring failure must be distilled above instance level; defensive baseline may advance but never silently regress).

units.name: Construction DNA
units.text: A full record per produced system capturing intent, system family, baseline generation, capabilities, architecture, primitives, recipes, dependencies, configuration, artifacts, state/runtime topology, deployment, tests, benchmarks, failures, iterations, human interventions, Production Reality, cost, time, quality, deviations — enabling comparison of why one build was near-one-shot and another needed 13 repairs.

units.name: Construction Memory
units.text: The persistent store recording not just that a pattern exists but why it is reusable: problem solved, prerequisites, scope, tradeoffs, counterexamples, confidence, benchmarks, and known failure modes.

units.name: Construction Memory Integration
units.text: Every Construction Intelligence Record must link failures discovered, immunity consumed, and immunity created.

units.name: Context Budget as Hard Resource
units.text: Each baseline item is judged by expected decision value vs context cost; if it doesn't change decisions, it doesn't enter the capsule.

units.name: Context Integrity Pack
units.text: UBC production maturity pack activated when a decision depends on user/tenant/environment/role/lifecycle/temporal state; compiles context completeness, normalization, fallback, offline behavior, explainability.

units.name: Correct by Inheritance
units.text: Many correctness properties arrive for free because certified infrastructure imposes them (atomic writes, checksums, recovery, rollback, observability).

units.name: Crawl Cortex
units.text: The supervisory loop layer of Crawl OS, extended with a 6th loop (Semantic Drift Watch — detects selectors that still work but whose meaning shifted) and a 7th loop (Institutional Impact Watch — tracks what knowledge needs revalidation when external evidence changes).

units.name: Crawl OS
units.text: The pre-existing sovereign plane for external acquisition, redefined as "the model-independent, self-evolving External Reality Acquisition and Evidence Operating System responsible for discovering, acquiring, interacting with, normalizing, validating, versioning, monitoring and replaying digital evidence, while continuously reconciling changes in external reality against the institution's claims, capabilities and baselines" (line 54966). Owns Crawl Intent Compiler, Frontier Engine, Acquisition Strategy Router, Fetch/Browser fabrics, Extraction, Normalization, Evidence Integrity, Crawl Memory, Change Intelligence, Cortex, Governance.
entities: Crawl OS — External Reality & Evidence Plane

units.name: Critical Failure Fast-Track
units.text: High-severity incident triggers immediate exposure scan, emergency baseline candidate, and broad regression without waiting for multiple recurrences.

units.name: Critical Failure Premium
units.text: Data loss, security, corruption, and irreversible external effects can justify strong prevention even at low probability.

units.name: Critical Path Protection
units.text: Universalization of "if the Main Thread notices you're doing heavy work, you've failed" — every architecture must identify and protect its critical path (UI thread, request path, event loop, scheduler, etc.).
entities: IDENTIFY THE CRITICAL PATH AND DO NOT LET NON-CRITICAL WORK DEGRADE IT

units.name: Critical-Thread Safety Pack
units.text: UBC pack activated on UI thread/event loop/game tick/request path/scheduler; compiles blocking-operation classification, I/O prohibition, async handoff, timeouts, completion semantics, thread ownership.

units.name: Cross-Project Failure Identity
units.text: Same failure mechanism across different repos should be fused under one failure genome, with per-project manifests.

units.name: Cross-Session Failure Identity
units.text: The same failure reappearing in another session must be recognized and merged into family lineage, not duplicated.

units.name: Data Portability & Migration Pack
units.text: UBC pack activated on database/schema/representation/major-API/backend change; compiles export/backup, semantic mapping, loss analysis, cutover (partial, range cuts off at 26250).

units.name: Dead Rule Detection
units.text: A UKDL rule never retrieved, never applicable, never decision-changing may need reindexing, consolidation, or removal.

units.name: Debugging-Cost Distillation
units.text: Learn not just from the bug but why it was expensive to find, producing meta-improvements to the debugging system.

units.name: Debugging Experience Curve
units.text: For the same failure family, future diagnosis should be faster; if not, knowledge retrieval is failing.

units.name: Defensive Compounding Rate (DCR)
units.text: How much future prevention increases per observed incident.

units.name: Dependency Classification (REQUIRED/OPTIONAL/DEGRADABLE/FALLBACKABLE)
units.text: Every dependency should be classified so an optional integration failure cannot make the whole system unavailable.
units.canonical_key: dependency classification required optional degradable fallbackable

units.name: Diff-Driven Baseline
units.text: Meaningful diffs (e.g. pure function starts writing filesystem) activate new requirements automatically; the baseline follows the real software.

units.name: Distributed State Propagation Pack
units.text: UBC pack activated by multi-process/multi-server/pub-sub/shared-DB systems; compiles storage/messaging separation, invalidation delivery, anti-entropy, eventual consistency contract, missed-event recovery, ordering, idempotency.

units.name: Done-Gate for Fixes
units.text: A bugfix isn't Done merely by test-green; must demonstrate reproduction-no-longer-fails, regression exists, analogous cases considered, Production Reality, no hidden lower-level recurrence, and institutional learning disposition.

units.name: Doomsday Vault Principle
units.text: Universalization of KME's Doomsday Vault: any critical promise must survive failure of its advanced path via a tested fallback.
entities: PUBLICLY CRITICAL PROMISES REQUIRE A TESTED DEGRADED PATH

units.name: Double Immunity
units.text: A user correction must generate both Software Immunity (bug doesn't return) and Autonomy Immunity (human doesn't have to rediscover it).

units.name: Duplicate Capability Gate
units.text: Before creating a retry manager, logging abstraction, persistence layer, etc., Claude must consult existing authority and justify a new implementation.

units.name: During-Mission Done Gates
units.text: Each phase (implementation, integration, migration, Production Reality) gets its own mini-compiled Done check instead of one giant final gate.

units.name: During-Mission Recompilation
units.text: UBC recompiles the delta (not everything) when scope changes mid-mission (new dependency, persistence, API, async, risk increase).

units.name: Emergent Capability Detection
units.text: Detection of new problem classes that become solvable purely from the combination of existing mature capabilities, without anyone explicitly building them, followed by generating a benchmark to prove it.

units.name: Enforcement Classes
units.text: Five enforcement modes per compiled requirement, avoiding converting everything into a Hard Rule.

units.name: Environmental Failure Genomes
units.text: Paths, permissions, OS, shell, locale, timezone, dependency discovery, network, resource pressure — many "mysterious" bugs are environment assumptions.

units.name: Epistemic Type System
units.text: Types knowledge as Observation/Measurement/Claim/Hypothesis/Invariant/Counterexample/Decision/Requirement/FailureMechanism/Capability/Baseline/Prediction/Policy with defined legal conversions (e.g. Observation→Hypothesis legal; Hypothesis→Universal Baseline a "compile error" requiring evidence/repetition/transfer/production reality/regression proof/applicability).

units.name: Error Anticipation Protocol (Before/During/After phases)
units.text: Four-phase discipline requiring failure anticipation before planning, a Failure Forecast during planning, recomputation during execution on architectural change, and falsification-status check before Done.
units.canonical_key: error anticipation protocol before during after phases

units.name: Error-Proof Defaults
units.text: Conceptual defaults like atomic-by-default, typed-state-by-default, verified-integration-by-default, rollback-enabled-by-default.

units.name: EssentialsX Maturity Corpus
units.text: External donor corpus (6,700+ commits, Minecraft plugin) mined as a table of ~80 maturity lessons converted into universal baseline principles (compatibility-as-correctness, config-as-versioned-API, exactly-once side effects, event semantic fidelity, etc.).

units.name: Evidence-Bounded Opportunity Delegation
units.text: Opportunity Delegation upgraded to require demonstrated existing-capability check, gap, reuse potential, systemic leverage, validation plan, and risk before Claude auto-adds an improvement.

units.name: Evidence -> Doctrine -> Applicability -> Activation -> Enforcement -> Evidence -> Writeback Separation
units.text: Explicit architectural separation preventing UKDL from writing constraints directly on a mission, a single bug from auto-becoming a hard rule, or IFC converting "high leverage" into universal application unchecked.
entities: Evidence -> Doctrine -> Applicability -> Activation -> Enforcement -> Evidence -> Writeback Separation
units.canonical_key: evidence doctrine applicability activation enforcement evidence writeback separation

units.name: Evidence Mission Compiler
units.text: An evolution of the Crawl Mission Contract compiler that adds Claim Target, Required Evidence Type, Authority Requirements, Freshness Contract, Independence Contract, Contradiction Policy and Preservation Requirement to a crawl request.

units.name: Excellence Debt
units.text: The inverse of technical debt: debt incurred when a new subsystem does not adopt a baseline that KME already has proven mature, even if the subsystem otherwise "works".

units.name: Experience + External Evidence
units.text: The best model combines own incidents with external engineering knowledge rather than waiting to personally suffer every bug.

units.name: Explicit Pipeline Law
units.text: Universalization of KME's 8-stage IRE pipeline into a general rule that important transformations must be explicit staged pipelines with contracted intermediate states.
entities: IMPORTANT TRANSFORMATIONS SHOULD BE EXPLICIT PIPELINES WITH CONTRACTED INTERMEDIATE STATES

units.name: External Dependency Failure Genomes
units.text: 401/429/timeout/schema-drift/partial-service-availability patterns that benefit every future integration.

units.name: External Failure Intelligence
units.text: Security advisories, framework incidents, upstream bugs can become failure genomes even before CPP has suffered them.

units.name: Failure-Adaptive Execution Mode
units.text: If Execution Mode discovers a systemic failure family, it can temporarily raise analysis depth without converting every feature into Ultra Plan.

units.name: Failure Anticipation as Baseline
units.text: For relevant missions, Claude Code must automatically ask which failure families apply, which are dominated, which are frontier, and what high-risk assumptions the change introduces.

units.name: Failure Anticipation Quality
units.text: Measures which warnings changed useful decisions rather than rewarding paranoia.

units.name: Failure-Aware Baseline Compiler
units.text: Every Baseline Capability Pack must include an Applicable Failure Immunity Pack so new work inherits relevant partial-failure/rollback/idempotency/interruption/schema-drift/stale-reader learnings even unprompted.

units.name: Failure-Based Autonomy
units.text: Each eliminated known failure also increases one-shot probability, so UFIA-EBF directly feeds HIC-OAR.

units.name: Failure-Based Capability Ascension
units.text: If preventing a family requires a reusable primitive, UCR-CIF promotes it, closing all three flywheels together.

units.name: Failure-Based Capital Allocation
units.text: Each new failure genome feeds IFC, which decides which prevention investment yields greatest systemic leverage.

units.name: Failure Benchmark Retirement
units.text: Once dominated, a benchmark retires to the Regression Vault and a harder benchmark replaces it, composing defensive intelligence.

units.name: Failure Cluster Pressure
units.text: Bugs clustering near state synchronization or adapters can diagnose missing single-source-of-truth or wrong abstraction boundaries.

units.name: Failure Dataset Quality
units.text: Requires normalized taxonomy, deduplication, causal confidence, labels, lineage, applicability — garbage incident data produces garbage predictions.

units.name: Failure-Derived API Design
units.text: If an API repeatedly permits misuse, redesign the API rather than adding infinite documentation.

units.name: Failure-Derived Completion Standard
units.text: When a bug shows Definition of Done was insufficient, Done itself must change for all future applicable work, not just the one feature.

units.name: Failure-Derived Representation Improvement
units.text: Many bugs occurring because state representation doesn't model something imply a representation fix, not implementation fix, often high leverage.

units.name: Failure Detection Latency (FDL)
units.text: Time between failure introduction and its detection.

units.name: Failure Discovery Cost
units.text: Time from first symptom to root cause, to be reduced.

units.name: Failure Escape Rate
units.text: How many known failure families reach Production Reality without detection.

units.name: Failure Exams
units.text: Adversarial benchmarks proving a capability survives beyond happy-path.

units.name: Failure Family Authority
units.text: Per-family record of best current understanding, current prevention, current detector, relevant regressions, applicability — analogous to Capability Authority Registry.

units.name: Failure Forecast (UBC capsule field)
units.text: Capsule section listing only plausible failure families with risk mechanism, trigger, violated invariant, cheap falsification, required detector, Production Reality condition.

units.name: Failure Frontier
units.text: Known protected families form the floor; hardest unknown/unprotected families form the frontier, analogous to capability frontier.

units.name: Failure Frontier Research
units.text: Clusters of unknown bugs can activate Autoresearch, bringing external knowledge into the failure model.

units.name: Failure Immunity Compilation
units.text: UBC consults historical Failure Genomes compatible with Project Genome + Mission Genome + actual diff before implementation begins.

units.name: Failure-Impact Micro-Commits
units.text: When ROI justifies, separate root-cause fix, regression, generalized primitive, knowledge update, and baseline enforcement into distinct commits for provenance and rollback.

units.name: Failure Intelligence Import
units.text: External patterns must pass relevance, trust, and applicability checks before import — do not import superstitions.

units.name: Failure Knowledge Compression Ratio
units.text: How many historical incidents are represented by a small number of robust invariants.

units.name: Failure Knowledge Deduplication
units.text: Avoid near-duplicate UKDL rules; consolidate under a common causal abstraction.

units.name: Failure Knowledge Garbage Collection
units.text: Deprecate duplicate genomes, obsolete stack-specific rules, and redundant regressions while preserving provenance.

units.name: Failure Leverage Score
units.text: Score combining exposure fanout, severity, recurrence, prevention reuse, and human burden avoided for a bugfix's generalized prevention value.

units.name: Failure Memory Must Survive Session Loss
units.text: The flywheel cannot depend on the current context window; material incident capture must be durable.
entities: Failure Memory Must Survive Session Loss
units.canonical_key: failure memory must survive session loss

units.name: Failure Pattern Mining
units.text: With enough corpus, discover recurring invariants, weak boundaries, common assumptions, and high-rescue families, producing new UKDL candidates automatically.

units.name: Failure Policy Economics
units.text: Each preventive rule has prevention value, execution cost, false-positive cost, and complexity cost; only positive-expected-value rules are kept.

units.name: Failure-Preserving Refactor
units.text: Refactor must conserve both capability behavior and failure immunity, not only superficial green tests.

units.name: Failure Reproduction Rate
units.text: A known family with high recurrence should raise urgency.

units.name: Failure Science Layer
units.text: Layer that seeks causal laws, recurrence patterns, predictive signals, and prevention strategies, converting historical debugging into engineering science.

units.name: Failure Severity Classes
units.text: Taxonomy of cosmetic, functional, workflow-blocking, reliability, data-loss, security, and systemic severities with varying evidence burden and prevention strength.

units.name: Failure Surface Coverage / Failure Baseline Gap Report
units.text: Per-project report of known applicable failure families split into protected, unprotected, and unknown.
entities: Failure Surface Coverage / Failure Baseline Gap Report
units.canonical_key: failure surface coverage failure baseline gap report

units.name: Failure-to-Immunity Latency (FIL)
units.text: Time from first incident to family-level protection.

units.name: Failure-to-Prediction Latency (FPL)
units.text: Time from first incident to capacity for anticipating analogous exposure.

units.name: False Activation Is a Bug
units.text: Activating disproportionate governance (e.g. full distributed-systems governance on a small utility) is a compiler error, not extra robustness.

units.name: False-Done Immunity
units.text: Every False Done must produce both a Product Failure analysis and a Verification Failure analysis, both closed.

units.name: False-Prediction Control
units.text: Measures useful predictions, false alarms, and investigation cost so prediction stays calibrated rather than paranoid.

units.name: Family Completeness Genome
units.text: Per software family, a maturity record of which Completeness Genome dimensions are proven (implementations A–M, proof systems A–Q, failure immunity A–S) versus the still-open gap T–Z.

units.name: Family Coverage
units.text: Per failure family, which variants are unknown, reproduced, protected, or predicted.

units.name: Feature Output = Artifact + Platform Improvement
units.text: A rule that every mission must produce two outputs: the product artifact (Output A) and the KME capability delta it created (Output B).

units.name: Final Law (Section CCIV)
units.text: No bug should only teach how to fix that bug; it must teach why the class fails, where else it can exist, how to detect/prevent it earlier, recognize variants, combine with other mechanisms, and raise the baseline for unwritten software.

units.name: First-Pass Production Correctness
units.text: Probability that Production-Reality-correct output is achieved on the first complete attempt; the mathematical target that should rise over time.

units.name: Five Mission Outputs (A-E Deltas)
units.text: Expands the four-delta framework to five: Product Delta, Capability Delta, Immunity Delta, Autonomy Delta, Institutional Delta — no important feature may terminate as product-only work.
units.canonical_key: five mission outputs a e deltas

units.name: Five Post-Mission Deltas (UBC)
units.text: Restates the five-delta framework specifically as UBC output; all can be zero except Product Delta, but must be evaluated.

units.name: Flywheel Optimization Objectives
units.text: Seven simultaneous optimization targets the flywheel pursues rather than quality alone.

units.name: Full CPP Mode vs Resident Institutional Kernel Split
units.text: Separation between full orchestration mode and the always-present minimal kernel that records repo/session/failures/fixes/decisions/interventions so no work is institutionally lost.
entities: Full CPP Mode vs Resident Institutional Kernel Split
units.canonical_key: full cpp mode vs resident institutional kernel split

units.name: Funnel Delta
units.text: An eighth per-incident output (alongside Product Fix, Evidence Record, Immunity/Baseline/Autonomy/Foresight/Experimental Deltas) recording what new dimension/question/branch of the consequence space must become available to future investigations because of this bug.

units.name: Gap Compilation
units.text: Every important improvement is formulated as current maturity, deficiency, target maturity, and validation, not a vague directive.

units.name: Gap-Driven Development
units.text: Universalized from KME's corpus→capability-inventory→measured-gap→implementation→metric-delta cycle, replacing vague "improve the architecture" requests.
entities: Current Capability -> Measured Deficiency -> Target Baseline -> Minimal Intervention -> Validation Metric -> Baseline Delta

units.name: Generalization Evidence Gate
units.text: A pattern seen once is a local candidate, several occurrences a primitive candidate, cross-project evidence a platform candidate — avoids premature abstraction.

units.name: Golden Path
units.text: The default "correct way" declared for a mature capability, which alternatives remain permitted but must be explicitly justified against.

units.name: Governed Output Entity
units.text: Every important output (dataset, build artifact, prompt, deployment, config, model) should have identity, hash, provenance, version, metadata, state, owner, validation, lifecycle, rollback, evidence — not just be a file.

units.name: Harder Failure Exams
units.text: After mastering exact failure, progression to variants, combinations, cross-environment, and unknown adversaries continually raises the defensive ceiling.

units.name: Historical Counterfactual Value
units.text: IFC prioritizes improvements by how many historical incidents they would have prevented retrospectively.

units.name: Historical Failure Replay
units.text: After improving baseline, re-run historical failures to ask if the current CPP would have prevented or detected them earlier, proving defensive compounding.

units.name: Historical Replay (UBC version)
units.text: Every new UBC version is tested against historical missions/bugs/rescues to confirm it improves the relevant Pareto before promotion.

units.name: Historical Software Maturity Distillation
units.text: Named sub-system within UFIA-EBF ingesting external corpora (starting with EssentialsX): history mining→bug/fix linkage→failure reconstruction→causal distillation→genome clustering→cross-domain abstraction→UKDL candidates→adversarial benchmarks→baseline promotion→Project Applicability Compiler.

units.name: Host Is Sacred
units.text: Universalized retrofit rule that the existing environment (host) has priority; a new feature (guest) must adapt and cannot break APIs, invariants, observability, or introduce another source of truth.
entities: EXISTING SYSTEM CONTRACTS ARE THE HOST

units.name: Human Attention Boundary
units.text: Separates decisions requiring human sovereignty (intent, taste, strategy, approval, irreversible external consequence) from machine-resolvable ones; Claude escalates only the former or genuine blockers.

units.name: Human-Discovered Bug Escalation
units.text: A bug CPP could have detected but the user found instead also feeds HIC-OAR, so the human isn't the primary detector again for that family.

units.name: Human-First Detection Rate (HFDR)
units.text: Percentage of failures the user detects first.

units.name: Human Intervention Gap Registry
units.text: Registry of human-rescue classes (missing test requests, visual mismatch reports, architecture selection, commit reminders, manual validation) each with frequency, cost, severity, automation feasibility, target autonomy level.

units.name: Human Intervention Prediction
units.text: UBC queries historical intervention patterns for similar missions to generate Autonomy Requirements the mission must try to avoid.
entities: WHERE HAVE HUMANS HISTORICALLY HAD TO RESCUE MISSIONS LIKE THIS?

units.name: IFC Inside the Compiler
units.text: IFC operates within a mission too, weighing direct/transitive/composition/meta/autonomy/failure-prevention leverage to justify fixing a foundational primitive vs a local workaround.

units.name: Immunity Blast Radius
units.text: If a prevention primitive changes, re-run regressions of the failure families it protects so defenses don't silently break.

units.name: Immunity Certificates
units.text: Mature primitives can declare which failure classes they're certified against, enabling verification amortization.

units.name: Immunity Composition
units.text: Two individually-safe primitives can fail together; component immunity ≠ composition immunity, integration still needs testing.

units.name: Immunity Coverage Map
units.text: Report showing exactly which causal variants of a solved-looking problem remain exposed, instead of a vague "solved" claim.

units.name: Immunity Dividend
units.text: One bug solved avoiding roughly 100 future bugs; IFC should measure it.

units.name: Immunity Maturity Ladder
units.text: Nine-level ladder (I0 Unknown to I9 Structurally Impossible) classifying how thoroughly a failure class has been mastered.

units.name: Immunity Without Bureaucracy
units.text: Best state is more protection with less manual ceremony; prevention should progressively migrate toward automation.

units.name: Immunity Yield Per Construction (IYC)
units.text: How much defensive capital each mission generates, used to detect missed universalization, not as a vanity metric.

units.name: Improvement Propagation
units.text: The process triggered when a capability improves (e.g. Terrain Seam Solver B5->B7), re-benchmarking representative downstream constructions to detect and promote composite baseline gains.

units.name: Incident Bisectability
units.text: History must allow identifying which commit introduced, fixed, and institutionalized a failure.

units.name: Inherited Maturity Ratio
units.text: Percentage of a feature's maturity that had to be invented locally versus inherited — the best flywheel indicator.

units.name: Initial Infrastructure Cost vs Marginal Feature Cost
units.text: Building the baseline costs more upfront but drives marginal feature cost sharply down thereafter.
entities: Initial Infrastructure Cost vs Marginal Feature Cost
units.canonical_key: initial infrastructure cost vs marginal feature cost

units.name: Institutional Compression
units.text: More historical knowledge should not produce longer prompts, it should produce better compiled defaults with smaller capsules.

units.name: Institutional Epidemiology
units.text: Analogy mapping bug=case, failure genome=mechanism, exposure graph=susceptible population, regression=diagnostic, primitive=vaccine, UKDL=doctrine, prediction=risk model; CPP should reduce systemic incidence, not just cure cases.

units.name: Institutional Evidence Producer
units.text: Every repo Claude Code touches becomes a producer of institutional evidence (architecture, commits, incidents, tests, fixes, corrections) with sanitization/abstraction.

units.name: Institutional Flywheel Controller (IFC)
units.text: Controller that receives failure genomes, recurrence, severity, affected consumers and prevention options, and decides where the next unit of engineering investment yields most institutional leverage.

units.name: Institutional Immunity Audit
units.text: When a known family reappears, audit capture, distillation, UKDL, retrieval, applicability, baseline compilation, enforcement, regression, and Production Reality to find the broken link.

units.name: Institutional Intelligence Engine
units.text: A pre-existing system that already formulated the Skill Projection Layer principle that a skill is a compilation/projection of institutional knowledge, not the canonical asset itself.

units.name: Institutional State Governance
units.text: A new proposed substrate beneath UBC/UCR/UFIA/HIC/KIFS/UDFLL/IRCF/ICAF/UKR/AutoResearch/Crawl OS that governs what can become institutional truth: how it becomes truth, who can change it, what depends on it, when it expires, and what happens if it turns out false — distilled from a Claude system prompt's memory_filesystem semantics (read-before-write, versioning, CAS, conflict detection, merge, authority/domain separation, append/patch/rewrite, lineage, deletion propagation, relevance-gated consumption).

units.name: Institutional WAL
units.text: A fast-path journal (event ID, evidence pointer, claim class, provisional interpretation) capturing material discoveries the moment they happen, before session end/compaction/crash/model handoff can lose them; UDFLL later compiles and deduplicates from it.

units.name: Interface Failure Genomes
units.text: Failures concentrate at boundaries (frontend/backend, process/filesystem, service/database, CLI/runtime, agent/tool) requiring special attention.

units.name: KIFS
units.text: Prior donor system referenced as the basis for USIFB, covering invariant hunting, semantic duplicate detection, cross-setup contamination, player-facing quality, adversarial review, repo-wide anomaly detection, diff intelligence, unknown-unknown discovery, counterfactual auditing, fresh-eyes review, blind-spot discovery, autonomous hypothesis generation.

units.name: KIFS (Kobii Institutional Foresight System)
units.text: The pre-existing institutional foresight engine that governs bug documentation and learning via an "inverted funnel" technique — expanding causally around a discovered mechanism (siblings, propagation, escape causes, latent contradictions, cross-domain applicability) before converging to a minimal high-ROI institutional response, rather than jumping directly from bug to fix to rule.
entities: KIFM (Técnica del Embudo / Bug Inverted Funnel)

units.name: Kill-Switch Compiler
units.text: Generates contextual stop conditions (e.g. new capability duplicates existing authority -> STOP; migration cannot rollback + high consequence -> STOP/APPROVAL).

units.name: KME-Style Gap Status
units.text: Gap lifecycle states inherited from KME so a capability is never falsely declared universally "resolved."

units.name: KME Universal Excellence Ratchet Flywheel
units.text: A universal architectural principle that every proven improvement discovered by one KME construction must lower the cost of every future construction that can benefit from it.

units.name: Knowledge Compression Through Root Causes
units.text: 100 bugs can reduce to 10 causal mechanisms and 5 foundational invariants — real compounding.

units.name: Knowledge Sovereignty Fabric
units.text: A pre-existing owner system that already defines Knowledge-to-Agent Capability Compiler, Knowledge-to-Workflow Compiler, and Knowledge-to-Test/Benchmark/Guardrail/CLI/Harness/Template Compilers, used as the correct owner for book-to-skill mechanisms instead of a new "Book OS".

units.name: Knowledge Strength Classification
units.text: UBC weighs UKDL entries by tier plus evidence age, counterexamples, applicability, supersession, so old/weak rules don't block the present.

units.name: Knowledge-to-Behavior Latency (KBL)
units.text: Time from a learning being discovered to future execution actually changing.

units.name: Knowledge-to-Production Compiler
units.text: The compiler that decides, per distilled knowledge item, whether the output should be SKILL, WORKFLOW, TEST, RULE, BENCHMARK, TOOL, PRIMITIVE, or NOTHING — not every dataset must produce a skill.

units.name: Knowledge Vault as Causal Dataset
units.text: With enough history, the Vault stops being documentation and becomes a dataset feeding planners, evaluators, adversaries, Autoresearch, IFC, and one-shot systems.
entities: A DATASET OF HOW SOFTWARE ACTUALLY FAILS UNDER CLAUDE POWER PACK

units.name: Knowledge Vault Lineage
units.text: Every UKDL rule must link conceptually to its source incident, root-cause evidence, tests, counterexamples, and promotion history.

units.name: Knowledge Vault Writeback
units.text: Rich incidents and evidence go to the Vault preserving circumstances, competing hypotheses, root cause, tests, causal chain, confidence, applicability, counterexamples — uncompressed.

units.name: KobiMapEngine (KME) Production Baseline
units.text: External donor architecture (KME) whose maturity discipline (living assets, verified Core vs debt vs vision, evidence gates, rollback, lifecycle, mode-aware audits) is proposed as a universal production baseline for all CPP code.

units.name: Latency-Unbounded Work Law
units.text: Do not place latency-unbounded work on a latency-critical execution path.
entities: KME's zero synchronous chunk loading -> universal

units.name: Live Human Intervention Ingestion
units.text: When a user intervenes, UBC asks why it was necessary, whether it was evitable, and registers avoidable cases as autonomy debt.

units.name: Live Opportunity Mining
units.text: Opportunity Delegation stays active mid-mission but every opportunity passes Gap->Existing Authority->Leverage->Cost->Risk->Scope before auto-inclusion.

units.name: Long-Horizon Autonomous Session Mode
units.text: A mode activated when architecture is broad, decisions depend on accumulated context, and iteration benefits from continuity, allowing the same agent to see build→bug→fix→measurement→next iteration without losing causal context, built on durable externalized state rather than an uninterrupted model context window.

units.name: LuckPerms Maturity Corpus
units.text: Second external donor corpus (LuckPerms permissions plugin, 2,269 commits) distilled into ~140 universal correctness lessons about context, caching, distributed sync, threading, APIs, and explainability.

units.name: MarkItDown
units.text: The existing document normalization layer, reinforced with the requirement to preserve raw original + normalized canonical form + structural metadata, never silently destroying tables/images/diagrams/attachments that carry material evidence.

units.name: Master Metrics Suite
units.text: Named metric set: Baseline Height, Baseline Coverage, Production Reality Pass Rate, First-Pass Production Correct Rate, Human Intervention Rate, Failure Recurrence Rate, Capability Reuse Multiplier, Institutionalization Latency, Time-to-Excellent, Search Waste.

units.name: Mastery Raises Immunity Floor
units.text: When a failure family is mastered, exact regressions go to the vault and baseline inherits prevention; the frontier moves to subtler failures.

units.name: Mature Engineering Reference Corpus / Production Maturity Gap Matrix
units.text: Comparison of a Mature Engineering Reference Corpus vs Current Repo Capability Model to produce a precise Production Maturity Gap Matrix.
entities: Mature Engineering Reference Corpus / Production Maturity Gap Matrix
units.canonical_key: mature engineering reference corpus production maturity gap matrix

units.name: Meta-Failure Genome
units.text: A failure genome one level up from software bugs, covering false universalization, promotion bias, benchmark blindness, knowledge accumulation without compression, self-confirming evidence, authority centralization, context overactivation, under/over-generalization, stale assumptions, evaluation contamination, self-ratification — each with detectors, benchmarks, replay and mutation tests.

units.name: Meta-Failure Genomes
units.text: CPP's own failure families — failed retrieval, failed universalization, false promotion, missed baseline, over-generalization, duplicate knowledge — must also be registered.

units.name: Micro-Commit Compiler
units.text: Recommends commit boundaries based on causal separability, verification, rollback, and institutional delta.
entities: ONE COHERENT VERIFIED CHANGE PER REVERSIBLE UNIT

units.name: Missed Activation Is a Bug
units.text: Failing to activate a needed gate (e.g. rollback during destructive migration) is equally a compiler failure — over- and under-engineering both matter.

units.name: Mission Baseline Capsule
units.text: The UBC's compiled output for one mission: Mission Intent, Reality Constraints, Applicable Capabilities, Applicable UKDL, Failure Immunity Pack, Autonomy Pack, Production Reality Contract, Completion Contract, Opportunity Envelope, Kill Switches, Verification Plan.

units.name: Mission Capsule
units.text: The UBC-compiled output for a mission — treated like an executable program compiled from mission genome, project genome, current baseline, institutional state, risk and tools into must/should/must-not/conditional/verification/fallback/authority directives.

units.name: Mission Genome
units.text: Description of what a specific mission modifies (type: feature/migration/bugfix/refactor/etc, touched boundaries, novelty, blast radius, reversibility, ambiguity, severity).

units.name: Mode Compiler
units.text: UBC replaces manual mode selection using novelty, blast radius, architectural uncertainty, reversibility, and evidence strength.
entities: Execution Mode / Plan Mode / Ultra-Plan Mode selection

units.name: Multi-Runtime Portability Pack
units.text: A UBC-compiled pack activated when a project spans multiple OS/runtime versions/providers/frameworks/platforms, bringing portable-core + adapter architecture.

units.name: New Construction Bootstrap
units.text: The startup procedure by which a new construction loads a pack of already-mature baselines (terrain integration, material semantics, BlockState fidelity, entrance continuity, rollback, performance, packaging, scene evaluation) instead of starting from scratch.

units.name: New North Star (Failure Surface Removed)
units.text: Reframes success from "how many bugs did we fix" to how much future failure surface each bug removed and how fast failures convert to universal immunity.
units.canonical_key: new north star failure surface removed

units.name: No Prompt Dependency
units.text: The user shouldn't have to re-request bug documentation each time; it must live in the global CPP execution constitution and Resident Institutional Kernel.

units.name: No Sacred Knowledge
units.text: If a UKDL rule causes recurring bad decisions, the rule itself becomes an incident and is reviewed.

units.name: No Unmodeled Mutation
units.text: Universalized "no direct placement" rule from KME: any high-risk mutation must have an explicit effect model before execution.
entities: NO HIGH-RISK MUTATION WITHOUT AN EXPLICIT EFFECT MODEL

units.name: Novelty Concentration
units.text: Fraction of engineering effort spent on genuinely novel work rather than boilerplate, logging, retries, migrations — should rise as baseline works.

units.name: Novelty Reward
units.text: A new failure family can carry great institutional value; deep analysis is warranted if severity/leverage justify it.

units.name: Observability Gap Detection
units.text: Some bugs cost hours because logs were poor; the observability lesson can be universal even when root cause is local.

units.name: One Failure → Many Tests Only When Justified
units.text: Don't artificially inflate the suite; use representative adversarial coverage — high coverage with low ceremony.
entities: One Failure → Many Tests Only When Justified
units.canonical_key: one failure many tests only when justified

units.name: One-Shot Target Definition
units.text: One-shot is redefined as one human intent converging autonomously to a Production-Reality-correct result, allowing internal replanning/rollback but not unnecessary debugging handback.
entities: ONE HUMAN INTENT -> AUTONOMOUS INTERNAL CONVERGENCE -> PRODUCTION-REALITY-CORRECT RESULT

units.name: Oracle Failure Genome
units.text: Evaluators/oracles can fail by families too, e.g. proving a function was called instead of proving its effect occurred.

units.name: Override Ledger
units.text: Records what/why/scope/risk/expiry/revisit-trigger when baseline is deliberately violated; human authority changes intent/risk acceptance, not verified reality.

units.name: Parity Matrix
units.text: A matrix declaring, per pair of interfaces (Make/CMake, CLI/UI, local/CI, Claude Code/headless), which capabilities are shared, which exceptions are legitimate, and which gates are equivalent, so alternative control paths never silently weaken correctness.

units.name: Pit-of-Success Engineering
units.text: Mature failure knowledge should make the correct path default and the incorrect path difficult.

units.name: Policy/Decision Explainability Pack
units.text: UBC pack activated when a system decides permission/routing/ranking/eligibility/workflow-branch/agent-selection; compiles decision trace, inputs/context, contributing rules, precedence, runtime inspector.

units.name: Post-Mission Compilation (UBC POST-COMPILE)
units.text: After implementation, UBC gathers construction evidence, test results, Production Reality, failures, interventions, performance, decisions, new capabilities/traps/gaps and determines institutional change.
units.canonical_key: post mission compilation ubc post compile

units.name: Predicted-Before-Incident Rate (PBIR)
units.text: Percentage of severe bugs flagged by the predictive system before reaching Production Reality.

units.name: Predictive Adversary
units.text: An adversary that uses failure genomes, architecture graph, and current diff to invent plausible unseen failure variants rather than only reproducing old bugs.

units.name: Predictive Bug Budget
units.text: Prioritizes which hypothetical bugs to pursue by probability × severity × exposure × detection difficulty × prevention ROI, integrated with IFC.

units.name: Prevention Ceremony Control
units.text: Not every rare bug should become ten universal gates; promotion requires severity, reuse, probability, and ROI to avoid institutional bureaucracy.

units.name: Prevention Distance
units.text: How early a failure is blocked on the ladder Production→Integration→Test→Build→Edit→Plan→Impossible-by-construction.

units.name: Prevention Hit Rate
units.text: How many projected failures are avoided before incident, measured via proxies and historical replays.

units.name: Prevention Recall vs Precision
units.text: Want to detect many true risks without flooding plans with irrelevant warnings; mission-specific compilation resolves this.

units.name: Privacy / Secret Distillation
units.text: Institutional knowledge must never require customer data, secrets, or proprietary contents; generalize causal structure only.

units.name: Process Deletion With Maturity
units.text: Maturity progression: remember rule -> follow process -> run validator -> impossible by construction, so baseline rises while ceremony falls.
entities: MANUAL PROCESS SHOULD DISAPPEAR BEHIND CERTIFIED INFRASTRUCTURE

units.name: Production Baseline Compilation (KME categories)
units.text: Universalized KME survival gates categories a mission passes before being considered good, blocking only where material consequence requires it.
entities: Source Authority / Existing Capability / Gap Traceability / Integration / Validation / Regression / Rollback

units.name: Production Baseline Generation (PBG)
units.text: Versioned baseline where each repo records an inherited generation number plus local exceptions.

units.name: Production Baseline Packs (Persistent State / External API / UI Effect)
units.text: Internal (not always-injected) packs auto-activating requirements like schema/atomic mutation/recovery for persistent state, timeout/retry/idempotency for external APIs, and reachability/effect verification for UI.
entities: Production Baseline Packs (Persistent State / External API / UI Effect)
units.canonical_key: production baseline packs persistent state external api ui effect

units.name: Production Estate Model
units.text: A model of everything actually participating in correctness beyond code — for a web app: frontend, backend, DB, Redis, queues, CDN, secrets, DNS, workers, feature flags, monitoring, deployments; for a Wii game: source, DOL, patches, assets, WBFS, USB loader config, save, hardware, cIOS, runtime state.

units.name: Production Maturity Ladder (P0-P10)
units.text: Eleven-level ladder from Implemented to Compounding used to grade production-grade maturity beyond binary Done.

units.name: Production Reality Contract Compiler
units.text: Compiles per-claim evidence requirements (e.g. "button works" requires user action->event->request->effect->feedback chain).

units.name: Progressive Knowledge Loading
units.text: A layered loading model (Layer 0 routing metadata → Layer 1 core doctrine → Layer 2 topic packs → Layer 3 deep evidence → Layer 4 raw sources) generalizing book-to-skill's core+on-demand-chapters pattern, plus a "Knowledge Paging" generalization to page by topic, failure family, architecture, environment or task stage.

units.name: Project-Agnostic Failure Capital
units.text: A bug found in any repo can raise CPP as long as it doesn't expose secrets, preserves privacy, and its causal abstraction is reusable.

units.name: Project Genome
units.text: Compiled technical context of a repo (language/runtime, architecture, persistence, statefulness, concurrency, external services, security, deployment, legacy constraints, known authorities/weaknesses/incidents).

units.name: Promotion Ladder
units.text: The staged ladder a capability climbs from LOCAL PATTERN through PROVEN PATTERN, CAPABILITY STANDARD, DOMAIN BASELINE to UNIVERSAL BASELINE, gated by accumulating evidence.

units.name: Public API Evolution Pack
units.text: UBC pack activated on SDK/plugin-interface/public-library/external-consumers; compiles semantic versioning, compatibility tests, breaking-change classification, migration guide, legacy shim lifecycle, consumer canaries.

units.name: Ratchet-on-Touch
units.text: New code must meet current baseline; old code must meet it when materially touched, except critical severity requiring immediate migration.
entities: NEW CODE MUST MEET CURRENT BASELINE / OLD CODE ON MATERIAL TOUCH

units.name: Ratchet Without Dogma
units.text: The floor can change shape with better evidence but must never fall accidentally.
entities: DO NOT SILENTLY FALL BELOW THE BEST CURRENT APPLICABLE VERIFIED BASELINE

units.name: Raw Evidence Vault
units.text: A storage plane that must remain strictly separate from the Knowledge Vault, preserving exactly what came from outside so that later-discovered false interpretations never destroy original evidence.

units.name: Reality vs Aspiration Classification
units.text: Universalized version of KME's MVP-demonstrated/debt/FINAL-aspirational/Derivation-Zone split, reducing "imaginary software."

units.name: Recurrence After Immunity (RAI)
units.text: Number of recurrences of a failure family after baseline promotion.

units.name: Recursive Definition of Done Growth
units.text: Each new failure discovered (e.g. restart/resume, rollback metadata, rollback-during-failure) permanently raises Definition of Done for all applicable future features; Done never silently regresses.

units.name: Regression Ownership
units.text: Every regression must indicate which failure family it protects, so its existence is explainable.

units.name: Regression Vault
units.text: Repository where old failure benchmarks are stored permanently once mastered, while the frontier continues.

units.name: RELATIONAL FAILURE GENOMES
units.text: A new class of Failure Genome that encodes relationships/interactions between multiple components or states rather than a single-function defect.

units.name: Reliability Confidence Ladder (R0-R9)
units.text: Ten-level ladder replacing binary Done with graded reliability confidence from claimed to baseline-certified.

units.name: Repeated-Bug Severity Escalation
units.text: Severity ladder for recurrence: first occurrence=failure incident, second=institutional recurrence, after UKDL promotion=knowledge application failure, after automated prevention=baseline enforcement failure.

units.name: Repeated Bugs Are Not More Bugs
units.text: Repeated known failures are evidence the flywheel did not close, not just additional bug count.
entities: Repeated Bugs Are Not More Bugs
units.canonical_key: repeated bugs are not more bugs

units.name: Representation Convergence Law
units.text: Distilled from LuckPerms issue #3008 (cache correct, persisted primary group incorrect).

units.name: Requirement Deduplication
units.text: Collapses multiple doctrines expressing the same requirement into one entry with multiple provenance links rather than repeating in context.

units.name: Resident Institutional Kernel
units.text: A kernel that observes material failures even in projects where CPP isn't fully activated, capturing locally before institutionalizing later.

units.name: Resource Liveness Semantic Lifecycle Law
units.text: Distilled from LuckPerms issue #4268 (cache eviction during a long connection phase).

units.name: Resource Pressure Knowledge
units.text: OOM, file descriptors, process limits, disk, latency, rate limits feeding capacity baselines.

units.name: Reuse Multiplier
units.text: A metric measuring how many subsequent constructions used an improvement produced by an earlier one.

units.name: Risk-Aware Context Budget
units.text: High-severity relevant families get more context; low relevance is omitted so huge history doesn't block reasoning.

units.name: Rollback Completeness Baseline
units.text: Example of a failure (rollback losing metadata) directly strengthening a versioned production gate that all applicable software inherits.

units.name: Root-Cause Reuse Multiplier
units.text: How many future incidents a root cause explains or prevents, rewarding causal depth.

units.name: Rule-to-Primitive Ascension Ladder
units.text: Maturity path where a rule stops being remembered and becomes implemented infrastructure (e.g. "avoid partial writes" becomes an atomic-write primitive).
entities: Knowledge Vault fact -> Trap -> Process Rule -> Hard Rule -> test -> validator -> primitive -> architecture

units.name: Scrapling
units.text: An external open-source adaptive crawling/extraction engine (1,600+ commits) providing selector resilience, session lifecycle, throttling and browser-pool management. Positioned as one donor "retina" engine inside Crawl OS's Acquisition Strategy Router, not an architecture to copy wholesale.

units.name: Search Space Collapse
units.text: With hundreds of missions of history, a new feature evaluates far fewer designs, reducing reasoning tokens, time, iterations, bugs, and human questions.

units.name: Self-Healing Selector Fabric
units.text: A capability inside Crawl OS that distinguishes Structural Recovery ("found something similar") from Semantic Validation ("proved same entity/field") and Historical Consistency, moving through confidence states EXACT→RELOCATED→SEMANTICALLY_VERIFIED or AMBIGUOUS/BROKEN.

units.name: Self-Immunizing Claude Power Pack
units.text: CPP must learn from bugs in its own systems; no exemption exists.

units.name: Session Close Failure Compilation
units.text: Before closing a relevant session, compile Failures Observed, Root Causes, New Failure Genomes, Exposures, Regressions, UKDL Delta, Baseline Delta, Prediction Delta.

units.name: Session Discovery Stream
units.text: An always-active capture stream in Claude Code that automatically records relevant technical and cognitive events from every tool surface (build, compiler, tests, runtime, terminal, CI, browser, emulator, hardware, debugger, git, deployment, telemetry, agent tools, user corrections) without relying on the agent's judgment of "this seems important."

units.name: Session Done-Gate Extension
units.text: An important session isn't closed until all material failures have dispositions, root causes are captured, regressions exist, generalization/exposure was evaluated, Vault/UKDL updated, baseline/predictive impact evaluated, and metrology meta-failures addressed.

units.name: Session Failure Checkpointing
units.text: Long sessions must checkpoint failures/learnings incrementally so an agent crash doesn't erase institutional knowledge.

units.name: Session Resume Immunity
units.text: On resume, Claude must know which bugs were found, which hypotheses were falsified, existing regressions, and pending UKDL changes to avoid paying rediscovery.

units.name: Shadow Compilation
units.text: A candidate UBC version compiles capsules in shadow alongside the live compiler; only the live one governs execution while outcomes are compared.

units.name: Shift-Left Failure Prevention
units.text: Doctrine that every failure should be pushed toward detection at an earlier lifecycle stage (production→integration→unit→static→architecture→primitive design).

units.name: Side Effect Retry After Partial Success
units.text: Synthesized failure class: side-effect retry after partial success can duplicate value when completion acknowledgement and commit are not atomic — applies to Stripe, queues, webhooks, jobs, inventory.
entities: Side Effect Retry After Partial Success
units.canonical_key: side effect retry after partial success

units.name: Single Pass vs Repeated Pass Law
units.text: Universalized from a KME "83/80 pass but 2/4 runs" observation.
entities: Single Pass vs Repeated Pass Law
A SINGLE PASS PROVES POSSIBILITY; REPEATED PASS PROVES RELIABILITY
units.canonical_key: single pass vs repeated pass law

units.name: Skill Projection Layer
units.text: The compiler stage that turns canonical distilled knowledge into an executable/JIT agent skill, kept strictly downstream of acquisition, normalization, semantic analysis, provenance, authority/confidence and distillation.
units.parent: Institutional Intelligence Engine / Knowledge Sovereignty Fabric

units.name: Software Evolution Intelligence
units.text: A capability that uses Crawl OS as a permanent sensor to detect new technology/tool/version evidence, run capability comparisons, adoption experiments and challenge existing baselines.

units.name: Source Authority Resolver
units.text: A new component separating "which source should be consulted" (installed implementation > official repo > official docs > release notes > issue tracker > secondary source > blog) from "how to acquire it" (Acquisition Strategy Router's job).

units.name: Source Existence vs Capability Existence
units.text: Universalization of KME's "file created ≠ feature implemented" wired/consumed/executed/observable requirement, fused with the Reality Contract.
entities: SOURCE EXISTENCE IS NOT CAPABILITY EXISTENCE / ACTIVITY PROOF IS NOT OUTCOME PROOF

units.name: Spec Gap Detection
units.text: Some bugs arise because the spec never defined an edge condition; the learning elevates requirements quality.

units.name: Specificity Preservation
units.text: UKDL holds compact abstraction while Knowledge Vault retains instances and edge cases — compression without amnesia.

units.name: State Transition Failure Graph
units.text: Model of invalid transition patterns for stateful systems to increase prediction.

units.name: Structural Immunity
units.text: Strongest prevention form is architecture where a bug can no longer be expressed; preference hierarchy documentation<process<test<validator<primitive<architecture<impossible-by-construction, gated by ROI.

units.name: Symptom-to-Genome Retrieval
units.text: A new error prompts consulting which known failure genomes produce similar symptoms, to generate better hypotheses.

units.name: Systemic Leverage Score
units.text: A prioritization score for capability improvements based on number of downstream systems, frequency of use, current weakness, expected quality uplift, and expected cost reduction.

units.name: Technical Autobiography Query
units.text: Ability to query accumulated history ("what have we learned about persistence") returning incidents, patterns, capabilities, failed approaches, current authority and baseline.

units.name: Temporal Failure Genomes
units.text: Some bugs require a sequence (start→partial update→crash→restart) rather than being purely structural; the genome must represent time.

units.name: Test Deletion Gate
units.text: Never delete a seemingly strange test without understanding what historical failure it protected.

units.name: Test-of-Tests
units.text: When a bug escapes a green suite, the verification system itself (metrology) must be repaired, not just the feature.

units.name: Test Suite Compression
units.text: When many regressions can be expressed better as a property/invariant/harness, consolidate to avoid infinite test entropy.

units.name: Third-Order Loop
units.text: CPP eventually learns which incident types produce highest-value universal rules and allocates more root-cause/research effort to those classes.

units.name: Time-Machine Immunity Test
units.text: Simulate a new baseline against old incidents to measure how many it would have eliminated, giving retrospective leverage.

units.name: Tiny Oracle First
units.text: The principle of building a cheap, structurally faithful oracle (tiny fixtures/synthetic model) before paying for production-scale verification, illustrated by kimi-k3-in-c testing its engine without downloading a 1.56TB checkpoint.
units.parent: Baseline Completeness Genome / Universal Evaluation Fabric

units.name: Tooling Gap Detection
units.text: Some bugs survive because inspection tooling doesn't exist; learning elevates the tooling baseline.

units.name: Total Leverage Formula
units.text: IFC's expanded leverage formula for deciding investment across capability/failure/intervention graphs.
entities: direct + transitive + compositional + preventive + autonomy + learning + future-search reduction

units.name: UBC Constitutional Laws (Section LXXX)
units.text: Block of thirteen capstone UBC laws (applicability precedes activation; absence must be established before reinvention; baseline strength must increase with evidence not document length; no universal rule is immune to supersession; every completed mission must leave future missions at least as well equipped).

units.name: UERAL (Universal External Reality Acquisition Layer)
units.text: A proposed layer giving the Engineering Foundation Runtime continuous perception of the external web/engineering ecosystem via governed acquisition. Initially pitched as a standalone system, then explicitly retracted in favor of extending the pre-existing Crawl OS rather than duplicating it.
units.canonical_key: ueral universal external reality acquisition layer

units.name: UFIA-EBF Final Pipeline
units.text: Named end-to-end pipeline bug→evidence→causal mechanism→failure genome→invariant→exposure graph→analogous bug search→adversarial family→regression→prevention→Knowledge Vault→UKDL→baseline→future planning prior→predictive failure pack→latent discovery→historical replay→measurable immunity→new frontier.

units.name: UKDL as Distilled Output of Failure Science
units.text: Over time UKDL should represent the invariants of highest explanatory/preventive power derived from all history, not a chronological list.
entities: UKDL as Distilled Output of Failure Science
units.canonical_key: ukdl as distilled output of failure science

units.name: UKDL Compilation (UBC function)
units.text: Filters UKDL by mission/architecture/risk/failure-surface/capabilities so Claude receives only the handful of rules that matter.

units.name: UKDL Compression
units.text: As knowledge grows, several rules ascend into one superior principle (e.g. several wiring checks -> "claimed effects require end-to-end causal reachability").

units.name: UKDL Confidence
units.text: Confidence tiering of universal learnings as PROVISIONAL, PROVEN, MATURE, or CONSTITUTIONAL.

units.name: UKDL Conflict Detection
units.text: Detects contradicting rules, requiring scope resolution, authority, and supersession — universal knowledge can drift too.

units.name: UKDL Distillation (UBC function)
units.text: Vault evidence is compressed into a distilled mechanism and Hard Rule/Process Rule/Trap candidate; UKDL never receives giant transcripts.

units.name: UKDL Effectiveness
units.text: Measures missions where a rule was applicable versus failures prevented/caught — UKDL needs outcome telemetry.

units.name: UKDL Promotion Gate
units.text: Gate requiring a local incident to pass reproduction, causal evidence, variants, analogous transfer, no fatal counterexample, and defined applicability before becoming a UKDL universal rule.

units.name: UKDL Quality Ratchet
units.text: The universal corpus must also improve in precision, applicability, compression, and predictive value — more UKDL is not necessarily better.

units.name: UKDL Revocation
units.text: Process for refining, scoping, deprecating, or revoking a UKDL rule when new evidence shows over-generalization or exceptions.

units.name: Universal Asset Lifecycle
units.text: Universalization of KME's map lifecycle states to any stateful object (jobs, sessions, caches, deployments, feature flags, artifacts): creation/activation/suspension/archival/deletion/cleanup/rollback.

units.name: Universal Baseline Compiler (UBC)
units.text: The institutional runtime that determines, per mission, which verified maturity CPP already has, what's applicable, what must be enforced/verified, what history should prevent errors, and what new learning should raise the future baseline.
entities: Recursive Production Maturity Runtime; Claude Power Pack Universal Baseline Compiler

units.name: Universal Capability Authority Registry
units.text: Per-capability registry of canonical provider, maturity, scope, versions, consumers, known limitations, tests, evidence, alternatives, deprecated implementations, so Claude asks for the certified baseline instead of reinventing it.

units.name: Universal Capability Extraction Layer
units.text: A post-mission process that asks what was learned that is not artifact-specific and classifies it as LOCAL, ARCHETYPE, DOMAIN, or UNIVERSAL, then promotes it to the matching scope.

units.name: Universal Discovery, Failure & Learning Ledger
units.text: A lossless causal memory system for everything Claude Power Pack discovers while building software. It captures not just bugs but any technically informative "discovery event" occurring during a session (compile errors, flaky tests, false assumptions, successful surprises, etc.) at zero loss, then selectively institutionalizes only what proves durable value.

units.name: Universal Engineering Foundation Baseline
units.text: The most complete, compilable, evaluated, self-evolving representation of everything Claude Power Pack knows about producing production software, modeled explicitly on a foundation-model architecture (inspired by Meta's Muse Glimmer 30B model card) but with explicit, auditable, evidence-grounded "parameters" (capabilities, failure knowledge, primitives, benchmarks, causal relationships) instead of opaque weights.

units.name: Universal Game Production & Evolution Platform
units.text: Institutional infrastructure ensuring every new game begins with all the engineering, evaluation, worldbuilding, rendering, tooling, debugging and production maturity acquired by all previous games, derived from analyzing Fable 5 World Demo's ("LAAS") production methodology as a baseline rather than a one-off achievement.
