units.text: A jump-height bug varied with framerate; fixed so apex height matched across 24 and 60 fps — generalizes to animations, retries, quotas, polling, physics, agent scheduling.
entities: TIME-BASED BEHAVIOR MUST NOT SILENTLY DEPEND ON EXECUTION RATE UNLESS INTENDED
units.canonical_key: time based behavior must not silently depend on execution rate unless intended

units.name: Time-step invariance pack
units.text: Proposed UBC pack activated when integrators, timers, simulation, animation, or rate calculations are present, enforcing frame-rate/time-step independence.

units.name: FAIL EARLY AT THE CAPABILITY BOUNDARY
units.text: LAAS added BrowserGate before any engine work to detect unsupported browser/mobile/missing WebGPU and give actionable instructions, rather than letting the system initialize 80% before revealing incompatibility.
entities: FAIL EARLY AT THE CAPABILITY BOUNDARY
units.canonical_key: fail early at the capability boundary

units.name: NEVER UPGRADE EXPECTATION TO VERIFICATION THROUGH WORDING
units.text: A commit fixed copy claiming other Chromium siblings "should work" when only Chrome was actually tested — a claim-evidence matching lesson.
entities: NEVER UPGRADE EXPECTATION TO VERIFICATION THROUGH WORDING
units.canonical_key: never upgrade expectation to verification through wording

units.name: Claim vocabulary epistemic precision
units.text: Distinct claim states — Tested, Expected, Supported, Known working, Untested — each a different claim, feeding KIFS Epistemic Integrity.

units.name: Platform scope explicitness (phantom portability prevention)
units.text: Safari/Firefox/mobile compatibility was never assumed; explicit platform scope prevents phantom portability claims.
units.canonical_key: platform scope explicitness phantom portability prevention

units.name: DETERMINISM IS DIAGNOSTIC INFRASTRUCTURE
units.text: LAAS made the world reproducible with ?seed=N, aligning frame indices and freezing motion/exposure, treating determinism as debugging infrastructure rather than only reproducibility.

units.name: Nondeterminism kill switches
units.text: Each relevant nondeterminism source (clock, seed, scheduling, network trace, model temperature) should have a kill switch to enable correct A/B comparison.

units.name: NEVER TRUST A DIFF UNTIL YOU KNOW WHAT ELSE CHANGED
units.text: Unaligned captures differed 20-27% from jitter/frame phase alone, and auto-exposure could turn a tiny real change into an apparent ~10% whole-frame difference — diff tests must control confounders.
entities: NEVER TRUST A DIFF UNTIL YOU KNOW WHAT ELSE CHANGED
units.canonical_key: never trust a diff until you know what else changed

units.name: Comparison harness confound registry
units.text: Before comparing, register/control random seed, time, cache, environment, exposure, state, version; UBC can activate the corresponding pack.
units.parent: NEVER TRUST A DIFF UNTIL YOU KNOW WHAT ELSE CHANGED

units.name: GOLDEN TESTS ARE NOT SACRED
units.text: After a legitimate semantic change (TRAA fix), pixel-equivalence floors had to be updated — golden baselines must be rebaselined with evidence when correct behavior legitimately changes.

units.name: Rebaselining requires cause/delta/approval
units.text: Rebaselining must not be automatic (else tests become rubber stamps) — requires documented cause, expected semantic delta, and approval/evidence.

units.name: TEST HARNESS CAN BE WRONG
units.text: LAAS documented traps in Vite watchers, code transformation, headless Chromium, and GPU timestamps — the test harness itself must be debugged; feeds the Metrology Incident concept.

units.name: PROVE THE SYSTEM IS EXECUTING THE CODE YOU THINK IT IS EXECUTING
units.text: Before changing hypothesis after an ineffective visual pass, verify the served module actually changed — applies to stale builds, caches, deployments, containers, hot reload.
entities: PROVE THE SYSTEM IS EXECUTING THE CODE YOU THINK IT IS EXECUTING
units.canonical_key: prove the system is executing the code you think it is executing

units.name: Artifact identity correlation baseline
units.text: Commit, build, deployed binary, and runtime must all be correlatable as a debugging baseline; combines with KIFS provenance.
units.parent: PROVE THE SYSTEM IS EXECUTING THE CODE YOU THINK IT IS EXECUTING

units.name: A SHARED API MAY HAVE CONTEXT-DEPENDENT SEMANTICS
units.text: cameraPosition meant different things depending on render pass (shadow pass used a different camera) — a shared global/reference must not be assumed to mean the same thing in every execution context; connects to LuckPerms context-bound values.
entities: A SHARED API MAY HAVE CONTEXT-DEPENDENT SEMANTICS
units.canonical_key: a shared api may have context dependent semantics

units.name: value without execution context may be incomplete state
units.text: Generalizes camera-context and LuckPerms permission-context lessons: a value's completeness requires its execution context, mirroring "A VALUE WITHOUT ITS AUTHORITY, FRESHNESS AND CONTEXT IS NOT COMPLETE STATE."
entities: value without execution context may be incomplete state
units.parent: A SHARED API MAY HAVE CONTEXT-DEPENDENT SEMANTICS
units.canonical_key: value without execution context may be incomplete state

units.name: Update order as explicit contract
units.text: Cloud lag revealed subsystems copied camera state before FlyCamera updated; event/scheduler/initialization ordering and state-snapshot timing must be explicit contracts when they affect correctness.

units.name: Works-after-manual-setPose does not prove works-during-real-frame-loop
units.text: Test path and production path can use different update orders, so a manual-invocation pass does not prove correctness in the real frame loop.
units.canonical_key: works after manual setpose does not prove works during real frame loop

units.name: Runtime state-update ownership visibility
units.text: Making explicit who updates state first and who reads it after, reducing temporal coupling.

units.name: SHARED MUTABLE STATE + PER-CONSUMER RECONFIGURATION = HIGH-RISK PERFORMANCE/CORRECTNESS PATTERN
units.text: The "hash storm" bug arose because the renderer mutated a shared shadow material per object, incrementing its version and triggering continuous rehashing.
entities: SHARED MUTABLE STATE + PER-CONSUMER RECONFIGURATION = HIGH-RISK PERFORMANCE/CORRECTNESS PATTERN
units.canonical_key: shared mutable state per consumer reconfiguration high risk performance correctness pattern

units.name: CACHE KEY MUST REPRESENT ALL SEMANTIC DIMENSIONS THAT CHANGE THE RESULT
units.text: An initial per-material memoization would have collided builder states across geometries; correct caching needed per-render-object keys — extends LuckPerms-derived Cache Integrity.
entities: CACHE KEY MUST REPRESENT ALL SEMANTIC DIMENSIONS THAT CHANGE THE RESULT
units.parent: NO CACHE MAY EXIST WITHOUT A DECLARED FRESHNESS, INVALIDATION AND LIFECYCLE MODEL PROPORTIONAL TO ITS CONSEQUENCE
units.canonical_key: cache key must represent all semantic dimensions that change the result

units.name: Performance bugs as architecture-interaction bugs
units.text: Performance bugs can arise from interaction (version thrash + shared mutable override + renderer behavior) rather than a simply slow algorithm, enriching Failure Genomes.
units.canonical_key: performance bugs as architecture interaction bugs

units.name: High-frequency structural overhead elimination
units.text: Correct memoization eliminated hundreds of graph hashes per frame — IFC should recognize elimination of whole classes of repeated validation, not just micro-optimization.

units.name: DO NOT ERASE TYPE INFORMATION AT CRITICAL BOUNDARIES WITHOUT JUSTIFICATION
units.text: Universalizes LAAS's strict:true/zero-any TypeScript constraint into a language-agnostic principle about not erasing type information at critical boundaries.
entities: DO NOT ERASE TYPE INFORMATION AT CRITICAL BOUNDARIES WITHOUT JUSTIFICATION

units.name: types = layer, not reality oracle
units.text: Despite strict typing, LAAS still found runtime semantics not correctly represented by types — type systems are a layer, not a guarantee of runtime reality.

units.name: REPRESENTATION TRANSFORMS NEED ORIENTATION/UNIT/COORDINATE CONTRACTS
units.text: Captures were vertically inverted due to a render-target pixel-row convention mismatch, nearly invisible on symmetric content but obvious on trees — applies to images, coordinates, timestamps, byte order, dataframes, model tensors.

units.name: GOOD FIXTURES BREAK SYMMETRIES
units.text: Symmetric test fixtures can hide orientation bugs; good fixtures should be asymmetric, use boundary cases and distinct labels rather than "nice clean data."

units.name: A PASS CAUSED BY ACCIDENTAL INPUT STRUCTURE IS NOT ROBUSTNESS
units.text: Conifer needles accidentally survived a capture bug due to incidental normal orientation while broadleaf failed — exactly a KIFS Validity-by-Accident finding; sibling comparison (A passes, B fails) should not conclude B is broken without checking if A merely got lucky.
entities: A PASS CAUSED BY ACCIDENTAL INPUT STRUCTURE IS NOT ROBUSTNESS
units.canonical_key: a pass caused by accidental input structure is not robustness

units.name: FALLBACK/TOLERANCE MAY MASK INVALID INTERNAL STATE
units.text: DoubleSide rendering hid a reversed-winding bug for two phases until single-sided materials revealed it — applies to permissive parsers, retries, fallback providers, nullable fields, auto-recovery; KIFS should try operating without the masking layer when verifying invariants.
entities: FALLBACK/TOLERANCE MAY MASK INVALID INTERNAL STATE
units.canonical_key: fallback tolerance may mask invalid internal state

units.name: Debug configurations stricter than production
units.text: FrontSide/facedbg revealed winding issues; equivalent universal debug configs (strict parser, assertions, fail-fast, disabled sanitizer) detect invalid state before compatibility layers hide it.
units.parent: FALLBACK/TOLERANCE MAY MASK INVALID INTERNAL STATE

units.name: COMPONENT VALIDITY CAN DEPEND ON COMPOSITION ROLE
units.text: A tube without a base cap was fine attached to a parent but broken when reused as a free-standing deadfall — a reusable component must declare externally-provided assumptions (e.g. "parent closes boundary") that change with reuse context.
entities: COMPONENT VALIDITY CAN DEPEND ON COMPOSITION ROLE

units.name: Reuse-triggered hidden-assumption re-evaluation
units.text: Reuse should trigger asking "what invariants did the original context provide externally?" rather than assuming prior functioning transfers.
units.parent: COMPONENT VALIDITY CAN DEPEND ON COMPOSITION ROLE
units.canonical_key: reuse triggered hidden assumption re evaluation

units.name: ONE VALUE CONTROLLING MULTIPLE SEMANTIC DOMAINS CREATES HIDDEN COUPLING
units.text: A single flowStrength value influenced carving, moisture, vegetation, splats, and boulder placement, so retuning it for rendering reconfigured the whole world — thresholds had to be separated; generalizes to global status fields, single timeouts, single confidence thresholds, single retry counts.
entities: ONE VALUE CONTROLLING MULTIPLE SEMANTIC DOMAINS CREATES HIDDEN COUPLING
units.canonical_key: one value controlling multiple semantic domains creates hidden coupling

units.name: Parameter ownership baseline
units.text: A value should declare which subsystem owns its semantic tuning; downstream presentation issues must not be fixed by modifying the shared source.
units.parent: ONE VALUE CONTROLLING MULTIPLE SEMANTIC DOMAINS CREATES HIDDEN COUPLING

units.name: SCALE-DEGENERACY TESTING
units.text: UBC-activatable testing for algorithms valid at one scale that degenerate at another, motivated by horizon AO failing when projected sampling became sub-texel at distance.

units.name: Numerical degeneracy guards
units.text: Universal failure families: zero support, division by near-zero, normalize-near-zero, sub-pixel/sub-sample scale, empty weighted average.

units.name: EMPTY EVIDENCE MUST NOT SILENTLY BECOME A VALID ZERO
units.text: A bilateral upsample let all taps reject, fabricating a zero AO value; fixed by detecting support absence and using a safer fallback — applies broadly to analytics, search, voting, retrieval, AI confidence, metrics; connects to KIFS Epistemic Integrity (no samples = UNKNOWN/fallback, not 0).
entities: EMPTY EVIDENCE MUST NOT SILENTLY BECOME A VALID ZERO
units.canonical_key: empty evidence must not silently become a valid zero

units.name: Precision/quantization as correctness
units.text: Near-zero vector normalization, 8-bit banding, and float/index conversion bugs show data-type/precision choice is a correctness property, not just storage optimization; applies to money, timestamps, coordinates, probabilities, sensor values. Proposes a Precision Integrity Pack.

units.name: LIBRARY DEFAULT != APPLICATION-APPROPRIATE DEFAULT
units.text: GTAO default sample count cost ~50ms, and a default shadow-camera far plane silently produced empty shadow maps with no errors — tool defaults must be measured, not trusted; feeds a dedicated Silent-Default Failure Genome relevant to DB pools, timeouts, retries, queue sizes, memory limits.

units.name: ABSENCE OF LOW-LEVEL ERROR CHANGES THE PRIOR, NOT THE CORRECTNESS CLAIM
units.text: When onuncapturederror existed but frames went black without a captured GPU error, the system learned to prioritize logic/uniform bugs over low-level GPU errors — a causal-diagnosis prior-updating rule.
entities: ABSENCE OF LOW-LEVEL ERROR CHANGES THE PRIOR, NOT THE CORRECTNESS CLAIM
units.canonical_key: absence of low level error changes the prior not the correctness claim

units.name: Error taxonomy steering debugging
units.text: Different diagnostic signal types (no low-level exception -> look higher; validation error -> look at contract; incorrect runtime output -> look at semantics) narrow the search space; UFIA+IFC can learn which evidence predicts which failure class.

units.name: A TEST MUST PUT THE PHENOMENON IN AN OBSERVABLE STATE
units.text: With the sun in the wrong orientation, shadows fell behind casters and visual inspection falsely concluded "no shadows" — a valid test action is insufficient if the expected effect is hidden by test conditions.
entities: A TEST MUST PUT THE PHENOMENON IN AN OBSERVABLE STATE
units.canonical_key: a test must put the phenomenon in an observable state

units.name: Testability as a design requirement
units.text: If a capability cannot be observed, the fix is to add a debug mode, inspector, probe, or state endpoint — treated as massive leverage.
units.parent: A TEST MUST PUT THE PHENOMENON IN AN OBSERVABLE STATE

units.name: DIAGNOSTIC REPRESENTATION NEED NOT LOOK LIKE PRODUCTION
units.text: Intentionally exaggerated diagnostic modes (class colors, face debug, raw velocity view, GI-only probe) make truth visible without matching production appearance.
entities: DIAGNOSTIC REPRESENTATION NEED NOT LOOK LIKE PRODUCTION
units.canonical_key: diagnostic representation need not look like production

units.name: Optimize using domain invariants
units.text: Contact-shadow early-exit was justified because contribution monotonically decreases so first-hit preserves output — optimization can exploit domain invariants (monotonicity, sparsity, idempotency, locality, linearity) rather than only compiler micro-tuning.

units.name: Algorithm properties as capability metadata
units.text: Monotonicity, sparsity, idempotency, locality, linearity should be captured as metadata to enable domain-invariant optimization.

units.name: Optimization knowledge maturation to certified primitives
units.text: Proven optimization patterns (batching, memoization, precompute, cache, incremental recompute) graduate from renderer-specific pattern to generic certified primitives.
entities: Optimization knowledge maturation to certified primitives
units.canonical_key: optimization knowledge maturation to certified primitives

units.name: UNDERSPENDING A DELIBERATELY ALLOCATED QUALITY BUDGET CAN BE A DEFECT
units.text: The brief treats under-rendering below triangle floors as failure because the target was maximal fidelity within a hardware budget — applicable to search depth, test-matrix size, compute usage, sample counts, but only where the baseline explicitly sets a quality floor.
entities: UNDERSPENDING A DELIBERATELY ALLOCATED QUALITY BUDGET CAN BE A DEFECT
units.canonical_key: underspending a deliberately allocated quality budget can be a defect

units.name: Maximize value, not minimize resource usage
units.text: The correct optimization target is quality/resource subject to quality floors, not minimal resource usage per se — feeds IFC.
entities: Maximize value, not minimize resource usage
units.parent: UNDERSPENDING A DELIBERATELY ALLOCATED QUALITY BUDGET CAN BE A DEFECT

units.name: Ambition-in-target + evidence-in-architecture
units.text: LAAS's brief chose the more ambitious approach among alternatives but validated it through measurement and reverted failed attempts — CPP should combine ambitious targets with evidence-driven architecture decisions.
units.canonical_key: ambition in target evidence in architecture

units.name: HARD/TARGET/TIER-2/DEVIATION requirement tiering
units.text: Requirement classification (HARD=must, TARGET=aim, TIER-2=best effort, DEVIATION=accepted shortfall) preventing false Done claims.
units.parent: DEVIATION IS A STATE, NOT A SECRET
units.canonical_key: hard target tier 2 deviation requirement tiering

units.name: Owner target changes as binding mission state
units.text: A mid-project performance target increase was explicitly recorded as binding — owner corrections should update authoritative mission state, not survive only in chat.
entities: Owner target changes as binding mission state
units.canonical_key: owner target changes as binding mission state

units.name: Mission authority rehydration after compaction
units.text: STATUS.md explicitly preserves user directives and next actions across session boundaries so the owner shouldn't have to repeat them — feeds HIC-OAR.

units.name: Agent recovery after context loss
units.text: One of LAAS's strongest agent-specific lessons: context compression must not cause re-planning, forgotten failures, revived rejected hypotheses, or lost user constraints.

units.name: Agent reasoning experience curve
units.text: LAAS's later status entries show richer methodology than early ones (build -> ablations -> frame alignment -> thermal controls -> causal profiling -> differential debugging -> rejection discipline) — the trajectory itself is what should be institutionalized.

units.name: Meta-Immunity
units.text: Rather than only storing "bug X -> fix Y," Fable 5 shows "bug X taught us a better way to investigate all future bugs" — the biggest single point of the corpus.

units.name: Failure Investigation Compiler improvement per bug
units.text: Each bug can improve the Failure Investigation Compiler's methodology itself (progression: guess subsystem -> ablation matrix -> contrastive debugging -> frame-aligned controlled experiments) as a meta-capability feeding IFC.
entities: Failure Investigation Compiler improvement per bug
units.canonical_key: failure investigation compiler improvement per bug

units.name: Investigation cost optimization metrics
units.text: Tracks hypotheses tried before root cause, false paths, time to reproducer, time to causal isolation, human interventions — should trend down over time.
units.parent: Failure Investigation Compiler improvement per bug

units.name: Negative hypotheses training future search priors
units.text: A symptom that looked like "water" but was actually AO/terrain teaches a future classifier not to overweight visual location.
entities: Negative hypotheses training future search priors
units.canonical_key: negative hypotheses training future search priors

units.name: Symptom taxonomy vs causal taxonomy separation
units.text: "Black horizon" is a symptom; "unsupported bilateral sample set" is the mechanism — only the mechanism generalizes.
entities: Symptom taxonomy vs causal taxonomy separation
units.canonical_key: symptom taxonomy vs causal taxonomy separation

units.name: Context Substitution Failures
units.text: New failure superfamily where a correctly-named variable/API has had its runtime context silently substituted (scene camera -> quad camera, main camera -> shadow camera, source object -> generated proxy, current state -> previous frame); mined as KIFS hypothesis seeds.

units.name: Masking Layer Failures
units.text: Failure superfamily where fallback/tolerance mechanisms (DoubleSide, auto-exposure, recovery layer, default values, cache) make invalid internal state appear functional.

units.name: Measurement Confound Failures
units.text: Failure superfamily where observed improvement/regression is caused by frame phase, exposure, thermal state, overlapping GPU work, or viewport rather than the real change; universal for every evaluation system.

units.name: Temporal Staleness Failures
units.text: Failure superfamily where a component uses valid data from the wrong instant; extends beyond rendering to distributed systems, UIs, agents, caches, orchestration.

units.name: Approximation Regime Failures
units.text: Failure superfamily where an algorithm behaves correctly at normal scale but degenerates outside its regime (e.g. AO sample radius becoming subpixel); applies to statistical estimators, time windows, DB batch sizes, UI layout sizes, numeric algorithms.

units.name: Accidental-Pass Failures
units.text: Failure superfamily where a test succeeds because fixture/geometry/data happens to hide the defect; KIFS should actively perturb symmetry and structure to find these.

units.name: Instrumentation Reality Failures
units.text: Failure superfamily where a metric/profiler/debugger's actual semantics differ from what's assumed; feeds directly into Metrology Incident.

units.name: Interactive-Only Failure Families
units.text: Failure superfamily unreachable by static/harness paths, requiring a Real Interaction Pack covering input, timing, focus, pointer lock, animation, network races, resize; corroborated by LAAS's pointer-lock cooldown bug and its open "fall through ground" issue.

units.name: HIGHLY SOPHISTICATED VERIFICATION CAN STILL HAVE BLIND DOMAINS
units.text: LAAS's public open issue (falling through the ground after 5-10 seconds of walking) proves even mature automated visual/performance QA can leave an unaddressed interaction defect — direct evidence for KIFS's core thesis.
entities: HIGHLY SOPHISTICATED VERIFICATION CAN STILL HAVE BLIND DOMAINS
units.canonical_key: highly sophisticated verification can still have blind domains

units.name: Claim-surface coverage matrix
units.text: For every product promise, must record what test surface covers it, for what duration, over what state transitions, and under what real interaction — since LAAS's strong visual/GPU/determinism coverage didn't extend to collision/walking.

units.name: Test sophistication in one domain cannot compensate for zero coverage in another
units.text: Proposed as a UBC constitutional law: 100 brilliant screenshot tests do not prove collision correctness; 100 unit tests do not prove deployment correctness.
entities: Test sophistication in one domain cannot compensate for zero coverage in another
units.canonical_key: test sophistication in one domain cannot compensate for zero coverage in another

units.name: Continuous exploration testing
units.text: Autonomous exploration (autonomous walking for interactive worlds, autonomous browsing for websites, stateful random action sequences for APIs, long-horizon task execution for agents) that lets KIFS search for runtime failures nobody manually scripted.

units.name: SOME FAILURES REQUIRE EXPOSURE TIME
units.text: A bug appearing after 5-10 seconds would survive a one-frame test — memory leaks, timeouts, resource exhaustion, session expiry, drift, and accumulation bugs require long-duration correctness distinct from short smoke tests.

units.name: Exposure duration as claim evidence
units.text: A "works" claim must specify its exposure duration (1 second, 10 minutes, 24h) as workload-specific evidence.

units.name: Fable 5 derived UBC Baseline Packs
units.text: Fifteen new UBC packs derived from Fable 5: Empirical Debugging, Differential Diagnosis, Ablation & Causal Attribution, Deterministic Comparison, Temporal Correctness, Interactive Reality, Performance Metrology, Measurement Confound, Reference Delta Quality, Representation Integrity, Approximation Regime, Diagnostic Instrumentation, State Update Ordering, Accidental-Pass Adversary, Long-Horizon Exposure — each compiled only when applicable.

units.name: Four-genome UFIA-EBF extension from Fable incidents
units.text: A Fable-derived incident produces up to four genomes: Failure Genome (what mechanism failed), Diagnostic Genome (what experiment found it), Metrology Genome (what measurement was misleading), Prevention Genome (what structural design prevents it) — an upgrade over the prior single-genome model.
entities: Four-genome UFIA-EBF extension from Fable incidents

units.name: KIFS metrology-aware unknown-unknown questions
units.text: New KIFS questions derived from Fable 5: what does this conclusion depend on an unvalidated measurement for, what only works because the fixture is symmetric/favorable, what context is silently substituted, what temporal ordering is assumed, what fallback masks incorrect state, what phenomenon the test cannot actually observe, what benchmark measures something different from its name, what bug only appears during real interaction.
units.canonical_key: kifs metrology aware unknown unknown questions

units.name: perception -> instrumentation -> machine-verifiable property
units.text: Reinforces HIC-OAR: an owner observation ("clouds lag") becomes a frame-aligned temporal regression so the same defect class is never human-detected again — a route to eliminate Human Quality Policing.

units.name: RICH_INTERACTIVE_APP baseline
units.text: Example of Constitutive Baseline Ratchet reinforcement: once a motion regression harness proves constitutive for visually rich apps, the family baseline permanently includes static visual + temporal motion + interactive environment verification.

units.name: Metrology & Experimental Capital
units.text: Seventh capital type: persistent institutional capacity to formulate a hypothesis about software, design a discriminating observation, control confounders, and obtain sufficiently reliable causal evidence to act on.

units.name: Seven mission capital types
units.text: Extends the prior six mission capitals (Product, Capability, Immunity, Autonomy, Baseline, Foresight) with Experimental Capital as the Fable-5-derived seventh.

units.name: Root-Cause Search Compression
units.text: Measures how many hypotheses had to be investigated before reaching the real mechanism for each failure family, expected to shrink over time (10 -> 5 -> 2 -> predicted before failure) as evidence Knowledge Vault/UKDL/tooling raise debugging maturity.

units.name: Owner-to-Instrument Conversion Rate
units.text: Of problems initially detectable only by a human, what percentage becomes a metric, probe, validator, regression, or automated evaluator. Target increasing.

units.name: Measurement Trust Coverage
units.text: Of metrics used to declare performance/quality/correctness, what percentage has known semantics, environment, and confounders.

units.name: Hypothesis Waste Rate
units.text: Engineering effort spent on fixes that didn't move the target, added no other value, and were reverted; target is decreasing but not zero — experiments should fail cheaply.

units.name: Time-to-Discriminating-Probe
units.text: Time from "we have a confusing bug" to "we have a test that distinguishes the leading hypotheses" — argued to be a better debugging metric than Time-to-Fix.

units.name: Empirical-science debugging loop
units.text: The full agent debugging loop under this baseline: see phenomenon -> preserve evidence -> build reproducer -> identify confounders -> generate hypotheses -> find cheapest discriminating observation -> ablate/differential/probe -> refute -> localize real mechanism -> implement smallest causal fix -> verify target -> verify siblings -> verify measurement still valid -> convert bug into regression+tooling+Failure Genome+UKDL -> raise baseline.

units.name: WHEN A SOFTWARE CLAIM CAN BE TESTED, THE INSTITUTION MUST PREFER DISCRIMINATING EVIDENCE OVER INCREASINGLY ELABORATE SPECULATION
units.text: New CPP constitutional law from the Fable 5 distillation.

units.text: Perhaps the most important LAAS-derived law: a passing result's trustworthiness is bounded by the quality of the experiment that produced it.

units.name: Universal Autonomous Experimental Engineering Corpus
units.text: The proposed full distillation target for the Fable 5/LAAS repository (commits, STATUS.md, THREE-NOTES, DELTA, DEVIATIONS, probes, refuted hypotheses, optimizations, open issues) so future CPP code is born able to measure, falsify, explain, and self-correct.

units.name: CPP Software Engineering Evolution & Intelligence Platform
units.text: A universal engineering-evolution plane elevating the KMEIP philosophy (benchmark -> failure intelligence -> improvement -> harder benchmark -> new frontier) from KobiMapEngine to all engineering, with specialized profiles (SEEIP Core, Wii Production Intelligence Profile, KMEIP Profile, Web/Product Profile, Agent Systems Profile) sharing common institutional planes (Evidence Graph, Capability Graph, Failure Graph, Benchmark Registry, Difficulty Engine, UBC, UKDL, Knowledge Vault, KIFS/USIFB, UFIA-EBF, HIC-OAR, IFC, Production Reality).
entities: CPP Software Engineering Evolution & Intelligence Platform

units.name: WII SPECIALIZES THE UNIVERSAL PLATFORM; IT DOES NOT FORK ITS INSTITUTIONAL INTELLIGENCE
units.text: Architectural law ensuring Wii-specific discoveries flow back into the universal SEEIP rather than living in an isolated fork.
